checks.name: Production gate admits published version without bypass
Downloaded game initializes real participant runtime

scope: Production LauncherForm and LauncherEngine with actual GitHub download, integrity checks and actual player launch in an isolated copy of the existing 1.0.5 install. Buttons invoked through WinForms handlers; game audio disabled.
limitations: No hardware mouse input assertion; DrawToBitmap captures actual launcher controls, not the game window.
